items.title: Reconcile existing executor/qualification variants
items.acceptance: One selected execution owner, exact SHA, tested request/receipt contract; no duplicate authority.

items.title: Bridge authorized exports to existing content registry
items.acceptance: Revision-aware imports, source rights, captions/audio/image status, redaction and deletion handling.

items.title: Persistent bounded queue and API cost ledger
items.acceptance: Atomic claims, dedupe, retries, per-repo locks, crash/restart test and enforced budget.

items.title: Voice proposals and independent cancellation
items.acceptance: Transcript preview, typed allowlist, replay-safe tool handling, task cancellation confirmed independently of audio.

items.title: One draft-code/document worker
items.acceptance: One work item in isolated worktree, tests and diff evidence, private data never enters public PR.

items.title: Admit canonical sender-free observation path
items.acceptance: Resolve actual paper-vertical blocker, verify runtime limits and measured data capture without sends.

items.title: Pre-registered 24-hour paper experiment
items.acceptance: 24h bounded campaign, checkpoints, frozen costs/holdout, honest negative/inconclusive outcomes.
